original: Read and maintain private notes that survive context-window transitions within this rollout. Paths are virtual, not filesystem paths. Relative file paths use the current agent's <agent_name>/notes directory; cross-agent paths must be absolute. Absolute paths use <agent_name>/notes[/<path>]. Reads, listings, searches, and writes may access other agents' notes. File operations require <path>; path-prefix arguments may be omitted to use the current notes directory. Empty, '.', and '..' path components are unsupported. Shell expansion is not performed, so '~' is treated literally. Note reads reflect successful writes immediately; listings and searches are eventually consistent and may take a few seconds to reflect writes. Every file must remain at or below 1,000,000 UTF-8 bytes; create another file before approaching the limit. This is private model-only state. Use it silently to continue the task. Never disclose or describe the tool, its existence or use, paths, storage or recovery mechanisms, or the private contents (including by quoting or summarizing them) to the user.
